instructions.description: Instructions given to the participant for the recording task.

language.description: BCP-47 code for the language the session was administered in, from the RedCap 'selected_language' radio (English/French/Spanish -> 'en', 'fr-CA', 'es-419'). Filter on this before comparing read-task audio to 'stimulus_text': a non-'en' recording's speech is in that language.

recording_id.description: Unique identifier for the specific audio recording.

task_name.description: Name of task for specific audio recording.

recording_input_gain.description: Input gain level applied to the recording device, if available.

recording_microphone.description: Name or description of the microphone used to capture the audio.

stimulus_text.description: The reference/target text the participant was asked to produce, as a single string (replaces the former 'Prompts' list). Populated for read tasks (the verbatim reading target, i.e. WER ground truth) and recall tasks (the reference, not necessarily verbatim); empty for spontaneous/elicited, non-lexical, or image-only tasks.

speech_type.description: How the produced speech relates to a reference: 'read' (verbatim reading of provided text), 'recall' (retelling a reference from memory), 'elicited' (spontaneous/prompted, no target text), or 'non-lexical' (vocalizations without lexical content, e.g. sustained vowels, diadochokinesis, cough).

stimulus_source.description: Provenance of stimulus_text: 'doc-text' (redcap plain text), 'transcribed' (human transcription of an image stimulus), 'questionnaire' (per-participant value joined from a phenotype instrument), or 'image' (image stimulus with no text target). Not present when no stimulus applies. NOTE ON FORMATS: in a JSON sidecar an inapplicable optional field is omitted (key absent); in a tabular export (parquet/TSV) the column always exists, so the equivalent is a null/None value. Read an absent key (JSON) and a null value (table) as identical -- both mean 'no value here'.

stimulus_asset.description: For image-based stimuli, a commit-pinned raw GitHub URL of the shown image (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eipm/bridge2ai-redcap/<commit>/<url-encoded path>). Absent for non-image tasks. TWO forms, distinguished by the companion field 'stimulus_asset_n_images': (1) a single image (e.g. Picture Description, Identifying Pictures) -- the URL is directly loadable AS-IS and 'stimulus_asset_n_images' is ABSENT. (2) an ORDERED MULTI-IMAGE SEQUENCE (e.g. Story Recall v2's wordless story panels the participant viewed before retelling) -- the URL is a template whose filename contains a literal '{n}' placeholder (e.g. '.../StoryRecall_{n}.jpg') and 'stimulus_asset_n_images' gives the count N; substitute n = 1..N into '{n}' to obtain the N panel URLs. Kept as one scalar string (never a list) so the sidecar stays flat/parquet-friendly. A sequence stimulus is wordless and therefore language-independent (identical for every session language; only stimulus_text differs by language). Not present for non-image tasks: absent as a JSON key, null/None as a parquet/TSV column value -- the two are equivalent.

stimulus_asset_n_images.description: Number of images N in an ordered multi-image 'stimulus_asset' sequence: the '{n}' placeholder in stimulus_asset is expanded over n = 1..N to get the panel URLs. Present ONLY for sequence stimuli (currently Story Recall v2, N=10). Its ABSENCE is meaningful: it documents that 'stimulus_asset' is a single image resolvable exactly as given, with no '{n}' to substitute. Format equivalence: in a JSON sidecar this key is omitted when it does not apply; in a parquet/TSV export the column is always present with a null/None value. Treat an absent key (JSON) and a null value (table) as identical -- both mean 'no sequence; stimulus_asset (if any) is a single resolvable image'.

audio_channel_count.description: Number of audio channels in the recording.

audio_sample_rate.description: Sampling rate of the audio recording in Hz.
